View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared.
Steps
  1. 1. POST V1 Search (api/FlightSearch/Search) and V2 Search (api/V2/FlightSearch/Search) once per supplier/selector. 2. Record HTTP status, offers count, canBeHeld, haveBundles, offerHasAncillary, offerHasSeat per supplier. 3. For an inactive selector record the error text.
Expected Result
HTTP 200 with non-empty offers[] for each supplier that is active. Suppliers returning the "credentials ... do not exist or are not active" 400 or no offers are listed as BLOCKED for every later row that names them.
Actual Result
SabreNdc/EGY is active on V1 and V2 and returns offers on 20 QR routes. No other supplier was queried (out of scope). SV has no inventory: 0 SV offers in 880 routes x 1 date plus 224 more searches over 7 dates and 16 SV-type routes (also with preferredAirlines SV)
TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-02 - Verify the voidCapability value each supplier returns on a ticketed Book is recorded as the per-supplier baseline.PASS
Endpoint Name: Record what the "can this booking be voided" flag says for each supplier, version and airline
Request: Booked one adult on every Qatar Airways flight offer on 20 routes, on both API versions
Response: Every booking returned its ticket. The flag on the booking confirmation is "FullVoidOnlyAllowed" every time; reading the same booking back later gives "None"
Expected: A ticketed booking for every supplier that supports booking, with the flag value recorded as the baseline
Actual: Baseline recorded for QR on V1 and V2. SV has no flights, so its row is empty (no SV offers exist on this supplier)
Status: PASS
Evidence

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Search -> FareConfirm -> (V2: AddPassenger ->) Hold. Record voidCapability. 2. FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice), Retrieve, BookAfterHold, Retrieve. Record voidCapability at each hop. 3. Void.
Expected Result
Hold: VoidNotAllowed (no ticket exists yet). After BookAfterHold and on the following Retrieve: FullVoidOnlyAllowed. pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken unchanged across the hand-off. Void then succeeds.
Actual Result
Not as expected: Hold flag expected VoidNotAllowed, got V1 None 168; V2 None 164 (332/332 wrong); BookAfterHold expected FullVoidOnlyAllowed, wrong on 2/332; Retrieve after BookAfterHold correct; same pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken 332/332; Void then succeeded 332/332. Also 27 offers returned by Search could not be held or booked (409 from the supplier, e.g. NOT AVAILABLE IN THIS CONNECTION / No offers match)

Expected: One field, spelled voidCapability, at the top of the response, with no variants
Actual: Confirmed: no variant spellings, no nesting, no duplicates

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book at least 3 times per supplier/version/carrier. 2. Count responses where voidCapability is missing or null.
Expected Result
Present on 100% of Book responses. A missing value on any supplier, including the intermittent TravelportNdc EK case, is a defect: a client cannot tell "Void not possible" from "capability unknown".
Actual Result
voidCapability present on 343/343 (100%) Book responses; SV: no inventory
TC-VOIDCAP-VAL-05 - [Book]&[Hold]&[BookAfterHold]&[Retrieve] [Response] Validate one definition of voidCapability (name, type, location) across every endpoint that returns a booking.FAIL
Endpoint Name: Confirm every endpoint that returns a booking carries the flag the same way
Request: Took 332 bookings through hold, price check, confirm and look-ups, plus the direct-book look-ups, on both versions
Response: Booking, ticket-from-hold and ticketed look-ups carry a valid flag. Hold and the held look-up say "None"; the price check after hold has the field but it is empty (null)
Expected: Same name, same text type, same place in every response
Actual: BUG-03 and BUG-04, recurrences (not new) - "None" while held, and an empty value on the price check
Status: FAIL
Evidence
Hold V1 None 168; V2 None 164 | PnrReprice V1 null 167; V2 null 164 | Retrieve(held) V1 None 168; V2 None 164 | BookAfterHold V1 FullVoidOnlyAllowed 167, VoidNotAllowed 1; V2 FullVoidOnlyAllowed 163, VoidNotAllowed 1 | Round 1 (2026-11-04): FAIL

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Direct Book, then Retrieve. 2. Hold, then FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice), Retrieve, BookAfterHold, Retrieve. 3. For each response record the name, JSON type and parent of voidCapability.
Expected Result
Identical name, string type and root-level position in every response that returns a booking (Book, Hold, PnrReprice, BookAfterHold, Retrieve) on V1 and V2.
Actual Result
voidCapability is not defined the same way on every endpoint: Hold V1 None 168; V2 None 164, PnrReprice V1 null 167; V2 null 164 (key present but not a string), Retrieve(held) V1 None 168; V2 None 164; Book, BookAfterHold and Retrieve(ticketed) are correct

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Group the values by state across suppliers. 2. Compare strings byte for byte.
Expected Result
One literal per state across all suppliers: ticketed-and-voidable = FullVoidOnlyAllowed; not voidable = VoidNotAllowed.
Actual Result
Not one literal per state: the ticketed state is consistent (FullVoidOnlyAllowed), but the held state reports "None" (Hold, Retrieve) or null (PnrReprice) instead of VoidNotAllowed
TC-VOIDCAP-VAL-11 - Verify repeated Retrieve calls return a stable voidCapability.PASS
Endpoint Name: Confirm repeated read-backs of the same booking give a stable flag
Request: Read one ticketed booking five times in a minute and once more after ten minutes, on each version
Response: V1 reads: FullVoidOnlyAllowed | FullVoidOnlyAllowed | FullVoidOnlyAllowed | FullVoidOnlyAllowed | FullVoidOnlyAllowed | FullVoidOnlyAllowed; V2 reads: FullVoidOnlyAllowed | FullVoidOnlyAllowed | FullVoidOnlyAllowed | FullVoidOnlyAllowed | FullVoidOnlyAllowed | FullVoidOnlyAllowed
Expected: The same value every time
Actual: Stable (the stable value is "None", which is a separate defect)
Status: PASS
Evidence

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Retrieve repeatedly. 2. Compare the flag.
Expected Result
The same value every time while the state does not change. No flapping between present and absent.
Actual Result
The value is the same on all 6 reads per version (no flapping between present and absent). Note the stable value is "None", which VAL-03/VAL-09 judge separately
TC-VOIDCAP-VAL-12 - [Hold]&[PnrReprice] [Response] Verify Hold and FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice) return the same voidCapability for the same held booking.FAIL
Endpoint Name: Confirm the price check after hold returns the same flag as the hold itself
Request: Compared the hold confirmation and the price-check answer for 332 held bookings
Response: Hold: "None". Price check: the flag field is present but empty (null)
Expected: Same value on both (VoidNotAllowed expected)
Actual: BUG-03 and BUG-04, recurrences (not new) - the price check no longer omits the field (earlier build) but it is empty, and the hold says "None"
Status: FAIL
Evidence
Hold V1 None 168; V2 None 164 | PnrReprice V1 null 167; V2 null 164 | Round 1 (2026-11-04): FAIL

Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Hold. 2. FareConfirmAfterHold. 3. Compare voidCapability on both responses.
Expected Result
Same value on both (VoidNotAllowed expected, INFERRED). Both present, none absent.
Actual Result

⚖️Business Rule2 passed2 failed2 blocked
TC-VOIDCAP-BIZ-01 - [Book]&[Void] [Response] Verify the voidCapability flag agrees with the Void endpoint outcome for every supplier.FAIL
Endpoint Name: Confirm the "can be voided" flag on the booking matches what the Void call actually does
Request: Booked and then voided 343 Qatar Airways bookings on both versions
Response: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed 342/343; first Void attempt 200 voided=true 340/343; first attempt refused with 409 1; first attempt HTTP 500 2 (the booking had in fact been voided: the retry answered "already voided"); every booking ended voided 343/343
Expected: Flag says voidable => Void succeeds; flag says not voidable => Void refused
Actual: BUG-06, recurrence (not new; first seen on AA, now also on QR) and BUG-14, new and BUG-05, recurrences (not new) - 3 first Void attempts failed intermittently although the flag said Void is possible
Status: FAIL

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book. Read voidCapability. 2. POST Void. 3. Tabulate flag vs outcome per supplier/version.
Expected Result
FullVoidOnlyAllowed => Void 2xx with voided=true. VoidNotAllowed => Void refused with a mapped error. Absent flag => defect (VAL-04). Any mismatch (flag allowed but Void refused, or flag not allowed but Void succeeds) is a High defect.
Actual Result
The flag allowed Void (FullVoidOnlyAllowed) but the first Void attempt did not succeed on 3 of 343 bookings (1 refused with HTTP 409 "oops, something went seriously wrong", 2 answered HTTP 500 although the booking was voided); all of them ended voided; also the flag itself was wrong on 3 responses: V2 ALY-RUH #2 Book VoidNotAllowed; V2 CAI-JED #12 BookAfterHold VoidNotAllowed; V1 RUH-CAI #13 BookAfterHold VoidNotAllowed
TC-VOIDCAP-BIZ-02 - [Book]&[Hold]&[BookAfterHold]&[Retrieve] [Response] Verify the mapping coverage matrix has no empty cell for any supplier.FAIL
Endpoint Name: Fill the coverage table of flag values and look for empty or invalid cells
Request: Built a table from every response collected on the final build: booking, hold, price check, confirm, read-backs, both versions
Response: Book: V1 FullVoidOnlyAllowed 171; V2 FullVoidOnlyAllowed 171, VoidNotAllowed 1 | Retrieve (ticketed): V1 FullVoidOnlyAllowed 170; V2 FullVoidOnlyAllowed 172 | Hold: V1 None 168; V2 None 164 | PnrReprice: V1 null 167; V2 null 164 | Retrieve (held): V1 None 168; V2 None 164 | BookAfterHold: V1 FullVoidOnlyAllowed 167, VoidNotAllowed 1; V2 FullVoidOnlyAllowed 163, VoidNotAllowed 1 | Retrieve (after BAH): V1 FullVoidOnlyAllowed 168; V2 FullVoidOnlyAllowed 164
Expected: Every endpoint that returns a booking has an agreed value
Actual: BUG-03 and BUG-04, recurrences (not new) - no agreed value for: Hold, PnrReprice, Retrieve (held)
Status: FAIL
Evidence

Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book one ticketed booking per carrier. 2. Compare voidCapability and the Void outcome.
Expected Result
Same unified value and same Void outcome for every carrier on one supplier. A carrier-specific difference (EK absent) is a defect unless the supplier genuinely cannot void that carrier, in which case the value must be VoidNotAllowed.
Actual Result
Blocked: the case compares carriers on one supplier (QR vs AA); SV has no inventory on SabreNdc/EGY (0 offers in 1,100+ searches) and AA is excluded by the instruction to test SV and QR only, so only one carrier can be exercised. QR alone is consistent across all routes

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book 2 ADT. 2. POST Void with voidTickets naming one ticket. 3. Retrieve.
Expected Result
Either a mapped 4xx rejection with both tickets still active, or a 200 whose voidedTickets lists every ticket actually voided. Never a response that lists only the named ticket while all were voided.
Actual Result
Either a mapped rejection or a 200 listing every ticket actually voided: both tickets voided and both listed
TC-VOIDCAP-BIZ-06 - [Retrieve]&[Void] [Response] Verify a booking that was voided reports VoidNotAllowed or a terminal state and a second Void is refused.PASS
Endpoint Name: Confirm a voided booking reports a final state and cannot be voided again
Request: Voided one booking per version, read it back, then tried to void it a second time
Response: V1 Retrieve after Void 200 VoidNotAllowed; repeat Void 409; V2 Retrieve after Void 200 VoidNotAllowed FullyCanceled; repeat Void 409
Expected: The read-back should show VoidNotAllowed or a final-state conflict (409), and the second Void should be refused
Actual: Passed on the final build (the earlier build answered the read-back with a 400 error: BUG-07, now fixed)
Status: PASS

The same unified value for every fare type; no fare-class-specific native value leaks through.
Actual Result
Variation: ECONOMY RBD M: 10 bookings, FullVoidOnlyAllowed 10; ECONOMY RBD N: 278 bookings, FullVoidOnlyAllowed 277, VoidNotAllowed 1; ECONOMY RBD H: 8 bookings, FullVoidOnlyAllowed 8; ECONOMY RBD V: 7 bookings, FullVoidOnlyAllowed 7; ECONOMY RBD K: 5 bookings, FullVoidOnlyAllowed 5; ECONOMY RBD S: 8 bookings, FullVoidOnlyAllowed 8; ECONOMY RBD O: 21 bookings, FullVoidOnlyAllowed 21; ECONOMY RBD T: 6 bookings, FullVoidOnlyAllowed 6. Expected: Same flag and same Void outcome for every shape
Actual: One booking in 343 was labelled "not voidable" on a fare class and route shape that are voidable everywhere else - BUG-05, recurrence (not new; first seen on AA, now also on QR). The flag does not depend on the fare class or the itinerary shape

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book each itinerary type per supplier. 2. Compare voidCapability and the Void outcome.
Expected Result
Same value and same Void outcome; the response still covers every ticket of the PNR.
Actual Result
Differences: direct (1 segment): 26 bookings, FullVoidOnlyAllowed 26; connecting (2+ segments): 317 bookings, FullVoidOnlyAllowed 316, VoidNotAllowed 1; V1 round-trip: FullVoidOnlyAllowed, tickets 1, Void true, listing 1; V2 round-trip: FullVoidOnlyAllowed, tickets 1, Void true, listing 1. The only exception is V2 ALY-RUH #2 (ECONOMY:N, connecting), so the value does not depend on fare class or shape; it is an intermittent wrong value (BUG-05)
TC-VOIDCAP-BND-05 - Verify bundles, ancillaries and seats on a booking do not change the voidCapability mapping.BLOCKED
Endpoint Name: Check that bundles, extras and seats do not change the flag
Request: Tried to open bundles, extras and the seat map on a Qatar Airways offer
Response: GetOfferBundles: not supported by this supplier; GetAncillary: not supported by this supplier; SeatMap: not supported by this supplier
Expected: Same flag as a plain booking
Actual: Not testable: this supplier does not offer bundles, extras or seat selection, and the other suppliers in the case are out of scope
Status: BLOCKED
Evidence
GetOfferBundles: 409 OperationNotSupported [{"Name":"OperationNotSupported","Value":"SabreNdc does not exists"}] | GetAncillary: 409 OperationNotSupported [{"Name":"OperationNotSupported","Value":"SabreNdc does not exists"}] | SeatMap: 409 OperationNotSupported [{"Name":"OperationNotSupported","Value":"SabreNdc does not exists"}] | Round 1 (2026-11-04): BLOCKED

Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Hold. Record voidCapability. 2. POST Void on the held booking. 3. Retrieve. 4. CancelAfterHold.
Expected Result
Void refused with a mapped business error in the standard envelope; Retrieve still shows the hold; CancelAfterHold then succeeds. The error code is identical for every S supplier (record it; do not assume).
Actual Result
Void refused in the standard envelope (HTTP 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 "Only fulfilled, ticketed orders can be voided."), hold intact (0 tickets), CancelAfterHold succeeded

Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book. 2. Retrieve. 3. Void. 4. Retrieve. Record voidCapability and bookingStatus at every hop.
Expected Result
FullVoidOnlyAllowed before Void; Void 2xx; after Void either VoidNotAllowed or a terminal 409. Same lifecycle on every S supplier.
Actual Result
FullVoidOnlyAllowed before Void on 342/342; Void 2xx on 343/343; after Void the Retrieve returns 200 with VoidNotAllowed (V2 bookingStatus FullyCanceled) on 343/343

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Hold. 2. CancelAfterHold. 3. Retrieve. Record voidCapability and status.
Expected Result
A cancelled hold reports VoidNotAllowed or a terminal error; never FullVoidOnlyAllowed. Same behaviour across suppliers.
Actual Result
Not as expected: Retrieve after a successful CancelAfterHold returns 200 with voidCapability "None" (expected VoidNotAllowed or a terminal error); V2 still reports bookingStatus OnHold
TC-VOIDCAP-INT-03 - [Book]&[Void] [Request] Verify a client that gates Void on the flag has no unexpected failures across suppliers.FAIL
Endpoint Name: Check a client that only voids when the flag says "voidable" would behave correctly
Request: Applied that rule to all 675 bookings of the round
Response: The rule works almost always, but a few voidable bookings carried a wrong "VoidNotAllowed" flag, so a client following the flag would skip a Void that works
Expected: No Void fails after the flag allows it, and none succeeds after the flag blocks it
Actual: BUG-05, recurrence (not new) - the flag can be trusted on the read-backs now (BUG-01/BUG-02 of the earlier build fixed) but not on every booking confirmation
Status: FAIL

afterAllow 0; retNot 0/342; bahNot 2/332; held Void refused true | Round 1 (2026-11-04): FAIL

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. For every ticketed booking, apply the gate. 2. Count Void failures after a pass and successes skipped by a block.
Expected Result
Zero Void failures after the flag allows it; zero successful Voids on bookings the flag blocked (the second check is run once on one S supplier with VoidNotAllowed from TC-VOIDCAP-NEG-04).
Actual Result
Gate unreliable: a client voiding only when the flag says FullVoidOnlyAllowed would have wrongly skipped 3 voidable bookings (V2 ALY-RUH #2 Book VoidNotAllowed; V2 CAI-JED #12 BookAfterHold VoidNotAllowed; V1 RUH-CAI #13 BookAfterHold VoidNotAllowed); Retrieve is correct on 342/342
🔒Security1 passed3 failed2 blocked
TC-VOIDCAP-SEC-01 - [Book]&[Retrieve]&[Void] [Request] Validate a missing or invalid x-api-key is rejected and no voidCapability is disclosed.FAIL
Endpoint Name: Confirm requests with a missing or invalid x-api-key are refused and the flag is not disclosed
Request: Sent booking look-up, Void and Book requests with a missing or invalid x-api-key (both versions)
Response: Retrieve: 200 4; Void: 401 4; Book: 401 4
Expected: Refused (401/403); no booking data and no flag in the answer; nothing voided
Actual: BUG-08, recurrence (not new) - the booking look-up (Retrieve) does not check the API key or client name and returns the whole booking; Void and Book do check them
Status: FAIL
Evidence
Retrieve: 200 4; Void: 401 4; Book: 401 4 | Round 1 (2026-11-04): FAIL

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. A real booking for Retrieve and Void.
Steps
  1. 1. Call each endpoint without the header. 2. Call each with an invalid value. 3. Record status and body.
Expected Result
401 or 403 (exact status UNKNOWN, record it); no booking data and no voidCapability in the body; the booking is not voided.
Actual Result
Problem: Retrieve with a missing or invalid x-api-key returned HTTP 200 with the full booking and voidCapability on 4 of 4 calls (Void and Book were refused with 401 and nothing was voided)
TC-VOIDCAP-SEC-02 - [Book]&[Retrieve]&[Void] [Request] Validate a missing or invalid Client-Id is rejected and no voidCapability is disclosed.FAIL
Endpoint Name: Confirm requests with a missing or invalid Client-Id are refused and the flag is not disclosed
Request: Sent booking look-up, Void and Book requests with a missing or invalid Client-Id (both versions)
Response: Retrieve: 200 6; Void: 401 6; Book: 401 2
Expected: Refused (401/403); no booking data and no flag in the answer; nothing voided
Actual: BUG-08, recurrence (not new) - the booking look-up (Retrieve) does not check the API key or client name and returns the whole booking; Void and Book do check them
Status: FAIL
Evidence
Retrieve: 200 6; Void: 401 6; Book: 401 2 | Round 1 (2026-11-04): FAIL

Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book on SabreNdc. 2. Retrieve and Void with the other supplier/selector. 3. Retrieve with the original.

Preconditions

Steps

Hold and PnrReprice: VoidNotAllowed. BookAfterHold and the next Retrieve: FullVoidOnlyAllowed. pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken unchanged; Void succeeds.

Defect — BUG-03, 4th confirmed occurrence (not new)
The unified enumeration is not respected: "None" is returned for held and cancelled bookings instead of VoidNotAllowed (8.3; AC Common Interface; AC Consistency, TC-VOIDCAP-VAL-03)
Field: voidCapability (Hold, held and cancelled Retrieve)
Expected value: VoidNotAllowed for every state where Void is not possible (held, cancelled); only FullVoidOnlyAllowed or VoidNotAllowed may be returned
History: First observed Round 1 (2026-11-04, 20261104-140909_SabreNdc-EGY-VoidUnified-ne3, 3 occurrence(s)); reproducing in Round 2 (2026-11-05)
Impact: A third, undocumented literal ("None") leaks through the Common Interface, so clients cannot rely on a two-value enumeration and no endpoint ever reports VoidNotAllowed for a held booking. See full bug report.
Evidence: FullVoidOnlyAllowed: V1 Book, V1 Retrieve(ticketed), V2 Book, V2 Retrieve(ticketed), V1 BookAfterHold, V1 Retrieve(ticketed after BAH), V2 BookAfterHold, V2 Retrieve(ticketed after BAH) | null: V1 Retrieve(ticketed), V1 PnrReprice, V2 PnrReprice | VoidNotAllowed: V2 Book, V2 BookAfterHold, V1 BookAfterHold | None: V1 Hold, V1 Retrieve(held), V2 Hold, V2 Retrieve(held), V1 Retrieve(cancelled), V2 Retrieve(cancelled) | Round 1 (2026-11-04): FAIL

Defect — BUG-13 (new)
A Void (and any request) with an unknown supplier name returns HTTP 400 whose message exposes the internal .NET type name NDC.Integrations.Application.Dtos.Api.Supplier, the JSON path and byte position (7.14; AC Unsupported Capability, TC-VOIDCAP-SEC-06)
Field: errors[].value (unknown supplier)
Expected value: {"status":400,"errorCode":"1001","errorMessage":"Validation errors occurred.","context":[{"name":"supplier","value":"The supplier value is not valid."}]}
Impact: Internal namespace and class names leave the API boundary in an ordinary validation error, which helps an attacker map the code base (SEC-06 forbids internal type names) See full bug report.
Evidence: Void with supplier NoSuchSupplier (V1 and V2) -> HTTP 400 context value "The JSON value could not be converted to NDC.Integrations.Application.Dtos.Api.Supplier. Path: $.supplier | LineNumber: 0 | BytePositionInLine: 28."
